description: Turkish Cay Black Tea is more than just a beverage; it is a symbol of hospitality and daily life in Turkey. Brewed in a traditional double teapot, or çaydanlık, it offers a robust, dark, and aromatic experience. Enjoy this staple of Turkish culture, perfect for sharing with guests or savoring during a quiet moment.

ingredients.notes: for boiling in the lower pot

instructions.title: Prepare the Çaydanlık (Double Teapot)
instructions.text: Fill the lower, larger pot of your çaydanlık with 1 liter of fresh cold water. Place it on the stove over high heat to bring the water to a boil.

instructions.title: Add Tea Leaves to Upper Pot
instructions.text: While the water in the lower pot is heating, add 2-3 tablespoons of high-quality Turkish black tea leaves into the upper, smaller teapot. The amount can be adjusted based on desired strength.

instructions.title: Steep the Tea Concentrate
instructions.text: Once the water in the lower pot is boiling vigorously, carefully pour about 250-300 ml of this boiling water into the upper teapot with the tea leaves. Place the upper teapot directly on top of the lower pot.

instructions.title: Allow Tea to Brew
instructions.text: Reduce the heat to low, ensuring the water in the lower pot continues to simmer gently. Allow the tea leaves in the upper pot to steep for at least 20-25 minutes. The steam from the simmering water below will gently brew the tea, extracting its full flavor and aroma.

instructions.title: Check Tea Readiness
instructions.text: The tea is ready when the leaves in the upper pot have settled to the bottom and the tea concentrate has developed a rich, dark red color. Do not stir the tea during brewing.

instructions.title: Serve Turkish Cay
instructions.text: To serve, pour the strong tea concentrate from the upper pot into traditional small, tulip-shaped tea glasses, filling them about one-quarter to one-third full. Then, dilute with hot water from the lower pot to your desired strength. Serve immediately, optionally with sugar cubes.

tips: Always use a traditional Turkish double teapot (çaydanlık) for the most authentic brewing method, as the steam-based brewing is key.
For the best flavor, use high-quality loose leaf Turkish black tea. The freshness of the tea leaves significantly impacts the final taste.
Never boil the tea leaves directly; the gentle steam from the lower pot is crucial for a smooth, non-bitter brew. Serve your çay hot and fresh.
